snippet.description:
Game: Valthirian Arc
Platform(s): Web Browser (Flash Game)
Developer(s): lucidrine / azraelee / AtelierLucid
Genre(s): RPG / Fantasy / Adventure
Release Date: March 07, 2010

--------------------How to play--------------------------
This game was played on Kongregate:
https://www.kongregate.com/games/lucidrine/valthirian-arc

--------------------About this Game--------------------------
Valthirian Arc series is an award-winning simulation RPG where you play as the principal of an academy in a magical fantasy world of Valthiria. Manage your school, take command of group of student on the journey of the quest and lead your academy to become the best in the kingdom.
